title: Humility and Death to Self
reading:
Humility is daily crucifixion. Self must decrease for Christ to increase.

Death to self is not dramatic — it is daily surrender in small things.
reflection: What rights am I unwilling to surrender? Where must I decrease? What does taking up my cross look like practically?
abide: It is no longer I who live, but Christ who lives in me. Let that truth settle slowly. That is not loss — it is the truest life.
